svg.title: E04: Multi-objective evolution and composition collaboration and interaction

text.tspan: Evolution · A² A2/A3 · fork join role collaboration
Candidate harnesses differ across at least two
A hard constraint failure cannot be hidden
1 propose(set) → 2 evaluate(candidates) → 3 report(frontier) → 4 select(components) → 5 compose(next) → 6 resample()
Evidence: 9/41 repositories, 8/36 families; 9 trajectories (7 multi-checkpoint); exact audit: not sampled.
Variation: Quality-cost trade-off, Pareto front, weighted fitness, and constraints.
Negative control: A single accuracy score is not multi-objective selection.
